First release.

- Connects the stock Kindle reader to calibre's wireless device connection: send and delete books over Wi-Fi.
- Shares calibre's USB book list, so books sent over USB and Wi-Fi are one library.
- Covers for MOBI/AZW3 books, with automatic repair of the Amazon "No image available" cover bug.
- Page numbers (APNX) for MOBI/AZW3 books.
- Read status and last-read date back to calibre (optional, two custom columns).
- One tap to connect, one tap to disconnect; Wi-Fi, sleep and the firewall are restored afterwards.

Tested on a Kindle Paperwhite 2, firmware 5.12.2.2. Install: unzip `calibre-wireless-1.0.0.zip` onto the Kindle's root. See the README for calibre setup.
